app_root.description: absolute path of the app checkout the scan ran against (optional)

id.description: rule_id#index, stable across repeated scans of the same page

rule_id.description: axe-core rule id, or a custom rule id such as keyboard-trap

wcag.description: axe tags starting with wcag (wcag2a, wcag412, ...)

help.description: axe failureSummary or the custom rule's remediation hint

route.description: page path where the element was found, e.g. /

selector.description: CSS selector for the failing element; rule_id + selector identify a violation

html.description: rendered outerHTML of the failing element (custom rules may truncate to the opening tag)

source.description: optional best-effort source location from Path 1; the fixer locates the file itself when absent

repro.description: custom rules only: how the failure was reproduced
